request.purpose: Fleet-card companion data the device sends alongside Segment 100 in a fleet-eligible financial transaction request
validationSources: Section 10.6 defers program-specific rules to Petroleum Industry Processing Specifications

authCompletion.purpose: Additional fleet-context data the device sends in an Auth Completion (0220) message when Host Prompts are supported
authCompletion.trigger: Auth Completion message type AND Host Prompts supported flag AND fleet-program prompt request

response.purpose: Fleet-specific response semantics are not defined in ATL105 Section 11 for Segment 101; response fields are carried by the outer financial response (see Segment 100 response knowledge). Program-specific response behavior may be defined in Petroleum Industry Processing Specifications.
validationSources: Section 11 response layouts do not enumerate Segment 101 fields

lifecycle.purpose: How Segment 101 participates when related requests and responses form a fleet transaction flow
lifecycle.fleetSpecific: Fleet Tags carry data captured at Host Prompt time; they are populated on Auth Completion and are not expected on subsequent cancellations or reversals unless the fleet program explicitly requires it.

boundaryRules.rule: Fleet Tags 1-5 are Auth Completion (0220) only; do not validate them as fields of the original request.
Do not validate response-side fields as Segment 101 request fields; Segment 101 has no defined response layout in ATL105.
Do not certify Segment 101 without Segment 100 present in the same message.
Segment 101 and Segment 145 must never coexist; reject any AI artifact that combines them.
Do not certify Petroleum Industry Processing Specifications or Enhanced Fleet (145) behavior using generic Segment 101 fixtures.
Do not certify Segment 101 for non-fleet card types (Appendix E fleet subset only).

artifactMapping.requestJson: test-data/*.json Financial Request that carries Segment 101 alongside Segment 100
artifactMapping.authCompletionJson: test-data/*.json Auth Completion that may carry Fleet Tags 1-5
artifactMapping.responseJson: outer financial response (validated by Segment 100 response knowledge)
artifactMapping.lifecycleJson: ordered message collection with fleet-tag population isolated to Auth Completion role
artifactMapping.brTsTcTd: Each domain-specific rule retains its source anchor across all artifact levels
